disposition.reason: An appeal of the Planning Commission's denial of site plan approval for an educational facility expansion that includes a building with faculty bedrooms. The documents never say anyone would live there long-term and full time, so it is not new housing.

evidence.quote: In Docket No. 35-3-04 Vtec, Appellant-Applicants appealed the January 28, 2004 decision of the Planning Commission of the Town of Dummerston, denying site plan approval for the same project.
CZMI is a not-for-profit educational facility providing graduate level instruction in psychoanalysis
to construct a new, separate residential building to house faculty bedrooms, student and faculty lounges, and a kitchen
construct new entrance drive, parking, apartment/[illegible], convert shed to lab.

judgments.note: Person rulings: faculty housing counts only for long-term, full-time living, and housing must be explicit; neither is established here.
